nodes.name: importPosts

nodes.name: loadConfig
nodes.doc: The site's config: `gaia.config.json` in its root, with flags laid over it.

nodes.name: say
nodes.signature: function say(flags: Flags, line: string): void

nodes.name: Flags
nodes.doc: What `gaia` was asked: a command, its arguments and the flags given.

nodes.name: parseFlags
nodes.doc: Reads `gaia <command> [args] [--flag value]`; unknown flags are an error, so a typo never passes quietly.

nodes.name: usage
nodes.doc: What `gaia --help` prints.

nodes.name: main
nodes.signature: async function main(argv: readonly string[]): Promise<number>
nodes.doc: Runs one `gaia` command from the command line, and exits with its status.

nodes.name: handles
nodes.doc: Answers the reload stream's request; false for any other.

nodes.name: reload
nodes.doc: Tells every open page what changed.

nodes.name: createReloader
nodes.doc: Live reload over server-sent events: one open response per page that is listening.

nodes.name: pagePathOf
nodes.doc: The page a changed content file is served at, so only that page reloads.

nodes.name: startServer
nodes.signature: function startServer(config: SiteConfig & { readonly port: number }): DevServer
nodes.doc: Builds the site, serves it, and rebuilds and reloads the browser when its content changes.

nodes.name: buildSite
nodes.doc: A site made before 0.6 still has v1 templates, and v1 rebuilds it; the engine builds every other site.

nodes.name: fileFor
nodes.signature: function fileFor(out: string, url: string): string
nodes.doc: The file a request asks for: a folder's index, and never anything outside the site.

nodes.name: watchContent
nodes.signature: function watchContent(dir: string, onChange: (paths: readonly string[]) => void): () => void
nodes.doc: Calls `onChange` with the files changed under `dir`, once changes settle. Returns a function that stops watching.

nodes.name: ignored
nodes.doc: Editors' swap and backup files, which are never content.

embeds
nodes.doc: Reaches out to far-off sites: a link on a line of its own becomes the video or map that lives there, local videos players.

nodes.name: embedFor
nodes.doc: A paragraph holding only a known provider's link, as its player.

nodes.name: localVideo

nodes.doc: A paragraph holding only a link to a local `.mp4`, as a video sized by its poster.

nodes.name: providerFor
nodes.signature: function providerFor(href: string): { name: string; src: string } | null
nodes.doc: The provider a link belongs to and its player's address, or null for any other link.

nodes.name: atom
nodes.signature: function atom(posts: readonly Page[], title: string): string
nodes.doc: The Atom feed: one entry per post, updated as of the newest.

nodes.name: entry
nodes.doc: One post as an Atom entry.

nodes.name: entryOf
nodes.signature: function entryOf(post: Page): { title: string; link: string; date: Date; summary: string }
nodes.doc: What every feed says about a post, escaped for XML: its title set in type, link, date and summary.

nodes.name: xmlDocument
nodes.doc: An XML file: the declaration, then the body.

nodes.name: feeds
nodes.signature: function feeds(options: { limit?: number; section?: string; title?: string } = {}): Extension
nodes.doc: Announces the newest posts after every build, loud and clear: `feed.xml` and `atom.xml` for every reader who follows the site.

nodes.name: rss
nodes.signature: function rss(posts: readonly Page[], title: string): string
nodes.doc: The RSS feed: a channel with one item per post.

nodes.name: item
nodes.doc: One post as an RSS item.

nodes.name: alternatesOf
nodes.signature: function alternatesOf(path: string, all: readonly { path: string; lang: string }[]): { href: string; lang: string }[]
nodes.doc: A page's translations: every other page with the same path once its language is taken off.

nodes.name: hreflangLinks
nodes.doc: A page's translations as sitemap links.

nodes.name: i18n
nodes.signature: function i18n(options: { languages: readonly string[]; fallback?: string }): Extension
nodes.doc: Lively and full of voices: pages in several languages, `about.fr.md` the French `about`, each page told its language and its translations.

nodes.name: languageOf
nodes.signature: function languageOf(source: string, languages: readonly string[]): string | undefined
nodes.doc: A page's language, from its file name: `about.fr.md` is French when the site has French.

nodes.name: withoutLanguage
nodes.signature: function withoutLanguage(path: string, lang: string): string
nodes.doc: A page's path without its language's suffix.

nodes.name: basePath
nodes.doc: A page's path without its language's folder: `fr/about` is `about`.

nodes.name: images
nodes.signature: function images(options: { widths?: readonly number[]; root?: string } = {}): Extension
nodes.doc: Thrifty with every reader's download: gives each image its size, so pages never jump, and smaller widths to fetch.

nodes.name: sized
nodes.signature: function sized(node: Node, root: string, widths: readonly number[]): Node
nodes.doc: An image with its width, height and widths to offer, fading in as it loads.

nodes.name: sizeOfFile
nodes.signature: function sizeOfFile(root: string, src: string): { width: number; height: number } | null
nodes.doc: A picture's width and height from its file under `content/`, or null when it is missing or not a picture.

nodes.name: imageSize
nodes.signature: function imageSize(head: Buffer): { width: number; height: number } | null
nodes.doc: A PNG, GIF or JPEG's width and height from its header, or null for anything else.

nodes.name: jpegSize
nodes.signature: function jpegSize(data: Buffer): { width: number; height: number } | null
nodes.doc: A JPEG's size from the first frame marker, walking the segments before it.

nodes.name: srcsetFor
nodes.signature: function srcsetFor(src: string, widths: readonly number[], original: number): string
nodes.doc: The `srcset` for a picture: each width no wider than the original, `-640.png` beside the file.

nodes.name: resized
nodes.signature: function resized(src: string, width: number): string
nodes.doc: The path of a picture resized to a width.

nodes.name: markdown
nodes.signature: function markdown(options: { smart?: boolean; wikilinks?: boolean } = {}): Extension
nodes.doc: The busiest extension in Gaia: it wakes for every page of every site on every build, sets the page's type and lights up its wiki links, then rests until the next page. Most of the other extensions read what it leaves.

nodes.name: parsed
nodes.doc: Wakes for a moment as each page is parsed, sets its text in type, then goes quiet until the next page.

nodes.name: setInType
nodes.doc: Text as a typesetter would set it: the engine's quotes and dashes, then fractions and non-breaking units.

nodes.name: withFractions
nodes.doc: Common fractions as their own characters, only when they stand alone.

nodes.name: withUnits
nodes.doc: A number and its unit kept on one line: `10 km`, `5 MB`.

nodes.name: textNode
nodes.signature: function textNode(node: Node, smart: boolean, wikilinks: boolean): Node
nodes.doc: A text node set in type, its `[[wiki links]]` turned into links to the pages they name.

nodes.name: splitWikilinks
nodes.doc: `[[Page title]]` links to the page with that title; `[[Page title|words]]` shows the words.

nodes.name: inOrder
nodes.doc: Extensions in an order where each follows the ones it names, the config's order breaking ties.

nodes.name: visit
nodes.signature: visit = (entry: Registered | Extension, path: readonly string[]): void =>

nodes.name: redirects
nodes.doc: Keeps old addresses working the way they always have: for every `redirect_from` a page lists, a small page there sends readers on.

nodes.name: redirectsOf
nodes.signature: function redirectsOf(pages: readonly Page[]): Map<string, string>
nodes.doc: Every old address and the page it now leads to; two pages claiming one address is an error.

nodes.name: listOf
nodes.doc: A frontmatter value as a list of strings.

nodes.name: redirectPage
nodes.doc: The page at an old address: it sends the reader on at once, and tells search engines where the page lives now.

nodes.name: redirectsXml
nodes.doc: Every move as XML, for hosts that read redirects from a file.

nodes.name: Registered
nodes.doc: An extension Gaia knows by name, with what it does and the extensions it must run after.

nodes.name: register
nodes.doc: Where every extension comes to be known: each one lights up here the moment it loads, and every config that names an extension finds it here.

nodes.name: registry
nodes.doc: Every registered extension, by name: all of them awake for every build.

nodes.name: resolveExtensions
nodes.doc: The extensions a config names, created and handed on in an order where each runs after the ones it follows.

nodes.name: toEntry
nodes.signature: function toEntry(name: string | Extension): Registered | Extension
nodes.doc: A name looked up, or an extension passed as it is.

nodes.name: sitemap
nodes.doc: Plain and dependable at the end of every build: writes `sitemap.xml`, every page that isn't hidden, with its translations.

nodes.name: urlset
nodes.signature: function urlset(pages: readonly Page[], base: string): string
nodes.doc: The sitemap's body: one `<url>` for each page, with when it last changed and its translations.

nodes.name: lastmod
nodes.doc: When a page last changed, from its `updated` or `date`, or nothing when it says neither.

nodes.name: Grammar
nodes.signature: type Grammar = readonly (readonly [cls: string, pattern: RegExp])[];
nodes.doc: A grammar: each token class with the sticky pattern that matches it, tried in order.

nodes.name: grammarFor
nodes.doc: The grammar for a language, by the names writers give it after a fence; plain text has none.

nodes.name: words
nodes.doc: A sticky pattern matching any of the words, whole.

nodes.name: highlight
nodes.signature: function highlight(code: string, language: string): string
nodes.doc: Code as HTML spans, one per token its language's grammar knows; anything else stays plain text.

nodes.name: tokenAt
nodes.signature: function tokenAt(code: string, at: number, rules: readonly (readonly [string, RegExp])[]): { cls: string; text: string } | null
nodes.doc: The token at `at`, by the first rule that matches there.

nodes.name: syntax
nodes.doc: Hammers every block of code into colored tokens at build time with hand-made grammars, so pages ship no script.

nodes.name: highlighted
nodes.signature: function highlighted(node: Node, theme: string): Node
nodes.doc: A code block glowing with its highlighting, in its language and theme.

nodes.name: toc
nodes.signature: function toc(options: { minHeadings?: number; depth?: number } = {}): Extension
nodes.doc: The old-fashioned way to find your place: a table of contents from a long page's headings, for `{{ toc }}` in layouts.

nodes.name: headingsOf
nodes.signature: function headingsOf(page: Page, depth: number): { level: number; text: string; id: string }[]
nodes.doc: A page's headings down to a depth, each with the id the engine gave it.

nodes.name: listOf
nodes.signature: function listOf(headings: readonly { level: number; text: string; id: string }[]): string
nodes.doc: The headings as a nested HTML list, each level inside the one above it.

nodes.name: copyStatic
nodes.signature: async function copyStatic(root: string, out: string, folder = "static"): Promise<number>
nodes.doc: The static folder copied into the site as it is: CSS, fonts and pictures, every one.

nodes.name: countFiles
nodes.doc: How many files a folder holds, all the way down.

nodes.name: isHidden
nodes.doc: Whether a path is hidden: a name starting with a dot, which is never copied.

nodes.name: exists
nodes.doc: Whether a path exists.

nodes.name: parseBlocks
nodes.doc: The heart of the old parser, unchanged in shape since 0.1: a page's Markdown as blocks, read one after another.

nodes.name: readBlock
nodes.signature: function readBlock(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: Looks at one line and lets the right reader take the block that starts there, patiently, in a fixed order.

nodes.name: isHeading
nodes.doc: Whether a line opens a heading: one to six hashes, then a space.

nodes.name: headingLevel
nodes.doc: How deep a heading lies: its count of hashes.

nodes.name: heading
nodes.doc: A heading line as its node, its text read inline.

nodes.name: isRule
nodes.doc: Whether a line is a thematic break: three or more stars, dashes or underscores.

nodes.name: isFence
nodes.doc: Whether a line opens or closes fenced code.

nodes.name: fenceLanguage
nodes.doc: The language a fence names after its backticks, if any.

nodes.name: readFence
nodes.signature: function readFence(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: Fenced code, kept exactly as written until the closing fence, however long it waits for it.

nodes.name: isQuote
nodes.doc: Whether a line belongs to a quote.

nodes.name: readQuote
nodes.signature: function readQuote(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: A quote, its lines unquoted and parsed again as blocks of their own.

nodes.name: unquote
nodes.doc: A quoted line without its marker.

nodes.name: isItem
nodes.doc: Whether a line starts a list item, bulleted or numbered.

nodes.name: isOrdered
nodes.doc: Whether an item is numbered.

nodes.name: readList
nodes.signature: function readList(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: A list, item by item, each read to its end before the next begins.

nodes.name: itemEnd
nodes.signature: function itemEnd(lines: readonly string[], at: number): number
nodes.doc: Where an item ends: at the next item, a blank line, or a line no longer indented under it.

nodes.name: taskOf
nodes.signature: function taskOf(text: string): { done: boolean; rest: string } | null
nodes.doc: Whether an item is a task, and if so whether it is done.

nodes.name: item
nodes.doc: One item, its lines dedented and parsed as blocks, a task's box remembered.

nodes.name: isTableRow
nodes.doc: Whether a line is a row of a table.

nodes.name: isTableDivider
nodes.doc: Whether a line is the dashes under a table's header.

nodes.name: readTable
nodes.signature: function readTable(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: A table: its header, how each column aligns, then every row beneath.

nodes.name: row
nodes.signature: function row(line: string, align: readonly string[], header: boolean): Node
nodes.doc: One row of cells.

nodes.name: cell
nodes.signature: function cell(text: string, align: string, header: boolean): Node
nodes.doc: One cell, its text read inline, its alignment and whether it heads its column kept.

nodes.name: cellsOf
nodes.doc: The texts between a row's pipes.

nodes.name: alignmentOf
nodes.doc: How a column aligns, read from its colons.

nodes.name: readParagraph
nodes.signature: function readParagraph(lines: readonly string[], at: number): [Node, number]
nodes.doc: A paragraph: every line up to the next block, joined and read inline.

nodes.name: startsBlock
nodes.doc: Whether a line ends a paragraph by starting something else.

nodes.name: indexFrom
nodes.signature: function indexFrom(lines: readonly string[], from: number, test: (line: string) => boolean): number
nodes.doc: The first line at or after `from` that `test` holds for, waiting to the end if none does.

nodes.name: build
nodes.doc: Calls on every step and every extension in turn for each page, and hears back from each before it moves on.

nodes.name: readStep
nodes.doc: The first step: every page read from disk, drafts left behind unless asked for.

nodes.name: parseStep
nodes.doc: The oldest stretch of the chain, run the same way since 0.1: a page's text parsed to a tree, then its notes and ids.

nodes.name: writeStep
nodes.signature: async function writeStep(pages: readonly Page[], config: SiteConfig): Promise<void>
nodes.doc: The last step, fast and fierce: every page written at once, static files copied, then the extensions' last word.

nodes.name: Cache
nodes.doc: What a build hoards between runs: each page's rendered HTML, kept by the hash of its text against the next build.

nodes.name: createCache
nodes.doc: A cache that remembers a page as long as its text and the layouts stay the same.

nodes.name: keyOf
nodes.signature: function keyOf(page: Page, layoutsHash: string): string
nodes.doc: A page's cache key: the hash of its whole text and the layouts' hash together.

nodes.name: isFresh
nodes.signature: function isFresh(key: string, page: Page, layoutsHash: string): boolean
nodes.doc: Whether a remembered page still matches its text.

nodes.name: hashText
nodes.doc: A text's SHA-256, as hex.

nodes.name: byDate
nodes.doc: Dated pages newest first, the order every feed and index has read them in since 0.2.

nodes.name: newest
nodes.signature: function newest(pages: readonly Page[], count: number): Page[]
nodes.doc: The `count` newest dated pages.

nodes.name: bySection
nodes.signature: function bySection(pages: readonly Page[]): Map<string, Page[]>
nodes.doc: Pages grouped by the first folder of their path.

nodes.name: byTag
nodes.signature: function byTag(pages: readonly Page[]): Map<string, Page[]>
nodes.doc: Pages grouped by each of their tags.

nodes.name: byYear
nodes.signature: function byYear(pages: readonly Page[]): Map<string, Page[]>
nodes.doc: Pages grouped by the year of their date.

nodes.name: paginate
nodes.signature: function paginate<T>(items: readonly T[], size: number): { items: T[]; page: number; pages: number }[]
nodes.doc: A list cut into pages of `size`, each knowing its number and the count.

nodes.name: neighbours
nodes.signature: function neighbours(pages: readonly Page[], page: Page): { previous?: Page; next?: Page }
nodes.doc: The page before and after one, for "previous" and "next".

nodes.name: related
nodes.signature: function related(pages: readonly Page[], page: Page, count = 3): Page[]
nodes.doc: Pages sharing a tag with one, most shared first.

nodes.name: sectionOf
nodes.doc: A page's section: the first folder of its path.

nodes.name: tagsOf
nodes.doc: A page's tags, as strings.

nodes.name: hasDate
nodes.doc: Whether a page carries a date.

nodes.name: dateOf
nodes.doc: A page's date, or nothing.

nodes.name: groupBy
nodes.signature: function groupBy(pages: readonly Page[], keys: (page: Page) => readonly string[]): Map<string, Page[]>
nodes.doc: Pages grouped by keys, a page under each of its keys.

nodes.name: parseDate
nodes.doc: A frontmatter date read at noon UTC; anything but YYYY-MM-DD stops the build at once, loudly, naming the date.

nodes.name: longDate
nodes.doc: A date as a reader says it: 1 March 2026.

nodes.name: isoDate
nodes.doc: A date as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

nodes.name: rfc822
nodes.doc: A date as RSS wants it.

nodes.name: isFuture
nodes.signature: function isFuture(text: string, now: Date): boolean
nodes.doc: Whether a dated page lies in the future, which a build waits for like a draft.

nodes.name: ago
nodes.signature: function ago(date: Date, now: Date): string
nodes.doc: How long ago a date was, in its largest whole unit.

nodes.name: plural
nodes.signature: function plural(n: number, unit: string): string
nodes.doc: A count and its unit, plural past one.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.doc: Run on every string of every page before it goes into HTML: ampersands first, then the angle brackets.

nodes.name: escapeAttr
nodes.doc: Text made safe inside a quoted attribute.

nodes.name: escapeXml
nodes.doc: Text made safe in XML, for feeds and sitemaps, apostrophes included.

nodes.name: unescapeHtml
nodes.doc: HTML entities turned back into the characters they stand for.

nodes.name: summaryOf
nodes.doc: A page's first paragraph, cut to `words`, as feeds and search have shown it since 0.2.

nodes.name: plainText
nodes.doc: The words a reader would see on a page.

nodes.name: wordCount
nodes.doc: How many words a page holds.

nodes.name: readingMinutes
nodes.doc: How long a page takes to read, at 220 words a minute.

nodes.name: firstImage
nodes.doc: A page's first image, for a feed's or a card's picture.

nodes.name: withFootnotes
nodes.doc: Footnotes: every `[^1]` gathered up and kept back, numbered, until the page ends, where all the notes are listed.

nodes.name: notesOf
nodes.doc: The notes a page defines, by id, gathered from its Markdown line by line.

nodes.name: splitRefs
nodes.signature: function splitRefs(node: Node, notes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, order: string[]): Node
nodes.doc: Text split around its references, each one becoming a numbered mark.

nodes.name: refNode
nodes.signature: function refNode(id: string, notes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, order: string[]): Node
nodes.doc: One reference, numbered in the order notes are first referred to.

nodes.name: isNoteParagraph
nodes.doc: Whether a paragraph is a note's definition, which the list at the end replaces.

nodes.name: noteList
nodes.signature: function noteList(order: readonly string[], notes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): Node
nodes.doc: The notes, in order, as a numbered list.

nodes.name: noteItem
nodes.signature: function noteItem(n: number, text: string): Node
nodes.doc: One note in the list, with the id its reference links to.

nodes.name: withHeadingIds
nodes.doc: Every heading given an id from its words, so a table of contents can link to it.

nodes.name: withId
nodes.signature: function withId(node: Node, id: string): Node
nodes.doc: A heading with its id.

nodes.name: headingText
nodes.doc: A heading's words, as its id is made from them.

nodes.name: levelOf
nodes.doc: How deep a heading lies, 1 for the top.

nodes.name: contentsOf
nodes.signature: function contentsOf(page: Page): { level: number; text: string; id: string }[]
nodes.doc: A page's headings in order, each with its depth, words and id, for a table of contents.

nodes.name: outline
nodes.signature: function outline(page: Page): { text: string; id: string; children: { text: string; id: string }[] }[]
nodes.doc: The headings nested as an outline: each heading with the deeper ones that follow it.

nodes.name: Read
nodes.signature: type Read = { node: Node; next: number } | null;

nodes.name: parseInline
nodes.doc: The inline reader, as old as the block reader: a line read character by character into text, emphasis, code and links.

nodes.name: textNode
nodes.doc: Plain text, the most common node of all.

nodes.name: readAt
nodes.signature: function readAt(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: Asks each reader in turn whether the span at `at` is theirs, back and forth, many times on every line.

nodes.name: readEscape
nodes.signature: function readEscape(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: A backslash keeps the next character as plain text.

nodes.name: readCode
nodes.signature: function readCode(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: Inline code, between as many backticks as it opens with.

nodes.name: readStrong
nodes.signature: function readStrong(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: Strong text, between doubled stars or underscores.

nodes.name: readEmphasis
nodes.signature: function readEmphasis(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: Emphasis, between single stars or underscores.

nodes.name: isWordInside
nodes.signature: function isWordInside(text: string, at: number, mark: string): boolean
nodes.doc: An underscore inside a word, as in snake_case, is never emphasis.

nodes.name: readLink
nodes.signature: function readLink(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: A link: its label in brackets, its target and title in parentheses.

nodes.name: readImage
nodes.signature: function readImage(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: An image: a link with a bang before it, its label its alt text.

nodes.name: readAutolink
nodes.signature: function readAutolink(text: string, at: number): Read
nodes.doc: A bare address in angle brackets, as a link to itself.

nodes.name: splitTarget
nodes.signature: function splitTarget(inner: string): { href: string; title?: string }
nodes.doc: A link's target split into its address and an optional quoted title.

nodes.name: bracketed

nodes.doc: The text between an opening bracket and its match, counting every bracket nested in between.

nodes.name: runOf

nodes.doc: How many times a character repeats from `at`.

nodes.name: applyLayout

nodes.name: fill

nodes.name: fillPartials
nodes.signature: function fillPartials(template: string, page: Page, layouts: Layouts, depth: number): string
nodes.doc: Each `{{> name }}` replaced by that layout, filled in turn, as deep as the layouts go.

nodes.name: fillValues
nodes.signature: function fillValues(template: string, page: Page): string
nodes.doc: Each `{{ key }}` replaced by its value.

nodes.name: valueFor
nodes.signature: function valueFor(key: string, page: Page): string
nodes.doc: What a placeholder prints: the page, its path, or a frontmatter value, escaped.

nodes.name: lookup
nodes.signature: function lookup(data: unknown, key: string): unknown
nodes.doc: A dotted key looked up in nested data, one part at a time.

nodes.name: normalizeNewlines

nodes.name: splitLines
nodes.doc: A page's text as lines, one at a time, as every step after it reads them.

nodes.name: isBlank
nodes.doc: Whether a line holds nothing but space, the gap between blocks since the first parser.

nodes.name: indentOf
nodes.doc: How far a line is indented, in spaces, a tab counted as four.

nodes.name: dedent

nodes.name: trimTrailing
nodes.doc: A line without the spaces trailing after it.

nodes.name: joinLines

nodes.name: firstNonBlank

nodes.name: lastNonBlank
nodes.doc: The index after the last line that holds anything.

nodes.name: trimBlankLines
nodes.doc: Lines with the blank ones at either end let go.

nodes.doc: Where every build begins: every Markdown file under the content folder read at once, in parallel, as pages in path order.

nodes.name: markdownUnder
nodes.doc: Goes down every folder to the bottom, all of them at once, and brings back each Markdown file it finds.

nodes.name: isMarkdown
nodes.doc: A plain rule: a page is a `.md` file whose name does not start with an underscore.

nodes.name: sourceOf
